texts.preamble: K.S.Prasad vs The Secretary To Government on 11 September, 2015 Author: M.Sathyanarayanan Bench: M.Sathyanarayanan In The High Court Of Judicature At Madras Dated: 11.09.2015 Coram: The Honourable Mr.Justice M.Sathyanarayanan W.P.No.28676 of 2015 K.S.Prasad ... Petitioner
texts.facts: 2. The petitioner joined the Government service as a Health Inspector Grade-IB in the year 1988 and the said post was subsequently re-disgnated as Health Inspector Grade-I in the year 1997. 3. The petitioner has further stated that one of his kidneys was removed on account of the fact that he was suffering from Renal Cell Carcinoma and now he is carrying on his activities with one kidney and in the light of the said fact he cannot consume much water and he is required to take proper care and treatment. 4. According to the petitioner, he has been working at Cheyyar from the year 2014 and therefore, he made a request for transfer to Chennai on medical ground by way of representation dated 25.05.2015.
texts.arguments: The grievance of the petitioner is that though the said representation was received and acknowledged by the respondents, he has not been favoured with any reply and hence, he has no other go except to approach this court by way of the present writ petition for appropriate relief.
texts.petitioner_arguments: The grievance of the petitioner is that though the said representation was received and acknowledged by the respondents, he has not been favoured with any reply and hence, he has no other go except to approach this court by way of the present writ petition for appropriate relief.
